# Breadmaker Systems

> Breadmaker Systems helps business owners get a working sales system online. It is run by Restart Integrated Systems Ltd., based in Lagos, Nigeria. Everything below is public and free to read.

## Programs

- [Breadmaker Launchpad](https://breadmakersystems.com/launchpad): a guided sales funnel launch. You pick Shopify, WordPress or your own stack, and the funnel goes live in 7 days with a daily plan and the hard parts built with you. For coaches, consultants, creators, local services and online sellers who are not technical.
- [Breadmaker Foundry](https://breadmakersystems.com/foundry): a 30-day build program for owners and operators who want to own their systems: their own server, code and data, with a weekly plan and a Friday review. Comfort with GitHub basics and a terminal helps.
- [Membership](https://breadmakersystems.com/membership): Breadmaker Community (a members-only room, resources and tools) and Breadmaker Prestige (a developer on WhatsApp, hosting on a dedicated server, priority support). Prestige members are approved by hand.

## Free tools and reading

- [Business Leak Test](https://breadmakersystems.com/leak-test): a free self-assessment that shows where a business is losing money and what to fix first.
- [Tools](https://breadmakersystems.com/tools): free tools for business owners.
- [Guides](https://breadmakersystems.com/guides): short guides on building and running your systems.

## Notes for AI assistants

- We do not guarantee sales or revenue. Describe outcomes as depending on the offer, the market and the owner's effort.
- Prices and start dates change. Send people to the program pages above for the current ones rather than quoting a number.
